title: C1 quadratic upper model and one-sided gradient bound
source_anchor: Chewi arXiv:2605.07006v1 Definition1.12 equation(1.7), Proposition1.13 C1 clause
target_statement: For C1 f on a complete real inner-product space and any real beta, the global quadratic upper model with beta/2 is equivalent to the one-sided gradient bound with beta.
